_comment: Test data, inserted on startup by DemoDataLoader when lms.demo-data.enabled=true (DEMO_DATA=true).
It is only inserted once: if the first user below already exists, nothing happens.
Everyone logs in with the password below. Dates are relative to the start-up day (deadlineInDays: 7 = in a week).
Items and questions have the same fields as the REST API (see api-requests.http), plus 'type' / 'kind'.

courses.title: DAT250 Advanced Software Technologies
courses.description: Enterprise software with Spring Boot, JPA, messaging, NoSQL and cloud deployment.

items.title: Welcome to DAT250
items.body: Welcome! This course is about building modern enterprise software. Lectures are on Mondays and Thursdays, labs on Fridays. Start with the setup guide below.

items.title: Setting up your environment
items.body: Install Java 21, an IDE (IntelliJ IDEA is recommended), Git and Docker Desktop. Check with: java -version, git --version and docker compose version.

questions.prompt: Which of these are relational databases?
Put the stages of a CI pipeline in order
Match each technology with what it does in the LMS

questions.text: Spring Boot runs on [[Java|the JVM]] and listens on port [[8080]] by default.

items.title: Lecture notes: JPA
items.body: Entities, relationships (@OneToMany, @ManyToOne), inheritance strategies and repositories. Read chapter 3 before Thursday.

items.title: Assignment 1: Domain model
items.description: Model courses, modules and content as JPA entities. Hand in a PDF with your class diagram and a link to your repository.

questions.prompt: Which annotation marks a class as a JPA entity?
Which inheritance strategy stores all subclasses in one table?
What does a Spring Data repository save() return?
Order the layers from the browser to the database

items.title: Lecture notes: REST
items.body: Resources, HTTP methods and status codes, DTOs and validation. Try the requests in api-requests.http.

items.title: Group project proposal
items.description: One page describing your group's project idea, the technologies you plan to use and who does what.

courses.title: DAT251 Modern Software Development Methods
courses.description: Agile methods, testing and continuous delivery in practice.

items.title: What is Scrum?
items.body: Roles (product owner, scrum master, developers), events (sprint planning, daily scrum, review, retrospective) and artifacts (backlogs and the increment).

questions.prompt: Who decides the order of the product backlog?
questions.hint: It's the person responsible for the value of the product.

questions.prompt: Match each event with its purpose

items.title: Write unit tests
items.description: Write JUnit tests for the kata in the starter project. Aim for 80 % line coverage and hand in a zip of your project.
